tools.name: git_add
tools.description: Adds file contents to the staging area. USAGE PATTERNS: Use `files: ['src/file.js']` for a single file, `files: ['src/']` for a directory, or `files: ['.']` to stage all changes.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

files.description: An array of file paths, directory paths, or patterns to stage (e.g., ['src/main.js', 'docs/', '*.md']).

tools.name: git_checkout
tools.description: Switches to a different branch. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this to start working on a different feature or to return to the 'main' branch.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

branchName.description: Name of the branch to switch to.

tools.name: git_clone
tools.description: Clones a remote repository into a new local directory.

source.description: The remote repository URL to clone from.

local.description: The local directory path to clone into.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Records staged changes to the repository with a commit message. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Run `git_status` and `git_diff_staged` before committing to ensure you are committing the correct changes.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_create_branch
tools.description: Creates a new branch. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: It's best practice to create a new branch for each new feature or bug fix. Use `git_checkout` to switch to the new branch after creation.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

baseBranch.description: The starting point for the new branch (e.g., 'main' or a commit hash). Defaults to the current HEAD.

tools.name: git_diff_staged
tools.description: Shows diff of changes that are staged for commit. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this as a final review before running `git_commit` to confirm exactly what will be included in the new commit.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Shows differences between various repository states. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: This is a flexible diff tool. To compare with a branch, use `target: 'branch_name'`. To compare two branches, use `target: 'branch1..branch2'`.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

target.description: Target to compare with. Can be a branch name, commit hash, or a range like 'branch1..branch2'.

tools.name: git_diff_unstaged
tools.description: Shows diff of changes in the working directory that are not yet staged, including untracked files. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this to review your current, un-staged modifications before deciding to stage them with `git_add`.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_get_ref_name
tools.description: Resolves a reference to its symbolic, human-readable name (e.g., gets 'main' from 'HEAD').

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

ref.description: The reference whose symbolic name to find (e.g., 'HEAD').

tools.name: git_get_repo_info
tools.description: Fetches essential repository structural information, such as the root directory path and .git path.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_init
tools.description: Initializes a new Git repository in a specified directory.

repoPath.description: Path to the directory to initialize the git repo in.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Shows the commit logs. Provides a list of recent commits with their hash, author, date, and message. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this to get context on recent changes or to find a specific commit hash for other commands like `git_show`.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of commits to show.

tools.name: git_merge
tools.description: Merges the specified branch into the current branch. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this to integrate feature branches back into your main branch. Handle conflicts if they occur.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

branch.description: The name of the branch to merge into the current branch.

tools.name: git_rebase
tools.description: Re-applies commits from the current branch onto a new base branch, creating a linear history. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this for a cleaner history than `merge`. Can cause conflicts that must be resolved.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

baseBranch.description: The branch onto which the current branch will be rebased.

tools.name: git_reset
tools.description: Resets the staging area. This unstages all currently staged changes, moving them back to the working directory. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this if you have staged files incorrectly with `git_add` and want to re-evaluate.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_resolve_ref
tools.description: Resolves a symbolic reference (like a branch name, tag, or 'HEAD') to its absolute commit hash.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Shows the changes introduced in a specific commit. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use `git_log` to find the commit hash you want to inspect, then pass it as the `revision`.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

revision.description: The revision to show (commit hash, branch name, tag, etc.).

tools.name: git_stash_list
tools.description: Lists all stashed changesets.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_stash_pop
tools.description: Removes a single stashed state from the stash list and applies it on top of the current working tree state.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

index.description: The index of the stash to pop (e.g., 0 for stash@{0}). Defaults to the latest stash.

tools.name: git_stash_push
tools.description: Temporarily shelves (or stashes) changes you've made to your working copy so you can work on something else. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this when you need to quickly switch context without committing half-done work.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

message.description: An optional message to describe the stash.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Shows the working tree status. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: This is the primary tool to understand the current state of the repository (current branch, staged, unstaged, and untracked files). Run this before and after major operations like `add`, `commit`, or `reset`.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_tag
tools.description: Creates a tag to mark a specific point in history, typically used for releases. Can create lightweight or annotated tags.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tagName.description: The name of the tag to create (e.g., 'v1.0.0').

message.description: If provided, creates an annotated tag with this message. Otherwise, creates a lightweight tag.

tools.name: git_worktree_add
tools.description: Creates a new worktree linked to this repository, allowing for concurrent work on different branches. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this to start a new task (e.g., a feature or bugfix) in an isolated directory without switching your main branch.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

path.description: The directory path for the new worktree.

branch.description: The name of the branch for the new worktree.

createBranch.description: If true, creates a new branch named after the 'branch' argument.

tools.name: git_worktree_list
tools.description: Lists all worktrees for the repository. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this to get an overview of all ongoing tasks and their corresponding directories.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

tools.name: git_worktree_remove
tools.description: Removes an existing worktree. AI DECISION GUIDANCE: Use this to clean up after a feature branch has been merged and is no longer needed.

repoPath.description: Path to the Git repository or any of its worktrees.

path.description: The path of the worktree to remove.
